اخترعا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَرَعَا (iḵtaraʕā) /ix.ta.ra.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# اُخْتُرِعَا (uḵturiʕā) /ux.tu.ri.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# اِخْتَرِعَا (iḵtariʕā) /ix.ta.ri.ʕaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
